plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-17 by live browser from Millersville University's official Coursedog catalog (catalog.millersville.edu); this plan's source_url is the program's official curriculum page. The live Undergraduate catalog page states: 'This publication is an announcement for the 2026-2027 academic year,' so this plan is filed under catalog year 2026-2027. The archived 2025-2026 catalog PDF's curriculum pages for these majors are blank, so the 2025-2026 tables could not be verified and were not used. The catalog publishes requirement tables only for this program: no official semester-by-semester sequence and no total degree credit figure appear on the program page, so this plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single requirements block, per the standing rule. The university-wide bachelor's minimum is 120 credits, including the Gateway General Education program (45-48 credits), which the program page does not itemize; the recorded total is the exact sum of the itemized major and required-related blocks transcribed here, not the 120-credit degree total. Coursedog display warning: each catalog block also shows a second 'Completion requirement' figure that in places disagrees with its block heading and row sums; headings and rows were transcribed as displayed and every disagreement affecting this plan is disclosed in these notes. 'Any X course(s)' pool rows on the catalog page show the summed credit value of the whole matching course pool, not a per-course credit; such blocks are recorded here as choice slots at the block's required credit amount. Major in Computer Science, BS (52 credits; minimum GPA 2.0; minimum residency 50% of major courses): Required Courses 40 credits (ten 4-credit courses, complete all) plus Electives 12 credits recorded as one choice slot. CMSC 380 is printed as 'CMSC380 Operating Systems or CMSC380H Operating Systems'; the honors variant is the same 4-credit requirement. Catalog elective note, verbatim in substance: 'May also take CMSC300. This requirement may not be satisfied with CMSC380 or CMSC420. Up to 4 credits of Co-op (CMSC300, CMSC400, CMSC500) are allowed. CMSC406 Topics courses may be selected if it is 4 credits.' Required Related (20-21 credits): Mathematics 14-15 (Calculus I MATH 161 at 4 credits, or Honors Calculus I MATH 163H at 5; MATH 235 Survey of Statistics 3; MATH 304 Matrix Algebra & Applications 4; Directed Math Elective at least 3, recorded as a 3-credit choice slot whose printed options are MATH 211 Calculus 2 (4), MATH 236 Elements of Statistics 2 (3) and PHIL 312 Mathematical Logic (3)) and Natural/Physical Sciences at least 6, recorded as one 6-credit choice slot (printed options include BIOL 100, BIOL 211, BIOL 221, CHEM 111, CHEM 112, ESSC 221/222/241/245/261, PHYS 131/231 and PHYS 132/232 at 0-5 credits as printed; catalog note: 'If selecting Physics choose PHYS131 OR PHYS231, PHYS132 OR PHYS232'). Recorded at the published minimum: 52 + 14 + 6 = 72 credits.

courses.title: CMSC 375-499 Electives
courses.choice_note: Catalog block 'Electives (12 credits), earn at least 12 credits: Any CMSC 375-499 course(s)'. The catalog page shows the pool total (318 cr) for this row, which is not a per-course credit; recorded at the block's required 12 credits. May also take CMSC300; may not be satisfied with CMSC380 or CMSC420; up to 4 credits of Co-op (CMSC300, CMSC400, CMSC500) allowed; CMSC406 Topics may be selected if it is 4 credits.

courses.title: Directed Math Elective
courses.choice_note: Catalog block 'Directed Math Elective (3 credits), earn at least 3': MATH 211 Calculus 2 (4 cr), MATH 236 Elements of Statistics 2 (3 cr), or PHIL 312 Mathematical Logic (3 cr). Recorded at the block minimum of 3 credits.

courses.title: Natural/Physical Sciences
courses.choice_note: Catalog block 'Natural/Physical Sciences (6 credits), earn at least 6 credits'. Printed options: BIOL 100 General Biology (3), BIOL 211 Concepts of Zoology (0-4), BIOL 221 Concepts of Botany (0-4), CHEM 111 Introductory Chemistry 1 (4), CHEM 112 Introductory Chemistry 2 (4), ESSC 221 Physical Geology (0-4), ESSC 222 Historical Geology (0-4), ESSC 241 Meteorology (0-4), ESSC 245 Environmental Meteorology (3), ESSC 261 Introduction to Oceanography (0-4), PHYS 131 Physics 1 with Algebra (0-4), PHYS 231 Physics 1 with Calculus (0-5), PHYS 132 Physics 2 with Algebra (0-4), PHYS 232 Physics 2 with Calculus (0-5). Catalog note: at least 6 credits of Natural/Physical Science courses; if selecting Physics choose PHYS131 OR PHYS231, PHYS132 OR PHYS232.
